title: Kusanagi Nene — I Can't Rest〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to start practicing for our show! Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are as energetic as ever today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, no doubt about that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But KAITO and the others aren't here yet, so I guess we should start with either a scene the four of us can rehearse or in-depth work on our individual roles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, I'd like to start with something that's been bothering me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that seems fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I've been having trouble with...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel relieved that we get to work on a show together like this.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness we managed to wake up from that dream...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was still doing everything I could in order to make my dream come true...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I ended up pushing myself a little too hard when I was on my own.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Is there a chance I would've gone down that road if things had been different...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Nene.
Are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, I was thinking about something else.
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You know the scene at the end where we all sing together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The way I've been singing just doesn't feel like the way my character would sing it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't really get that feeling when I heard you singing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Tsukasa's the one playing that character. So, there must be a reason behind him feeling this way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can we ask why you feel that's the case...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the city police officer finds no greater joy than in performing his job. At the same time, the citizenry sees him as a nuisance for how rigid he is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That same man is supposed to grow a heart and become more compassionate with each passing case...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I've been trying to capture that change in this song...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In other words, because he's undergone such a huge change of heart, you're not sure if you're doing a good job of showing that you're still playing the same character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Based on the way I heard you sing, it didn't seem like you ever broke character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, more specifically than just “the way you sing”, it might be some subtle nuance or method of expression that isn't quite clicking inside your head.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, could you all take a moment to listen as I sing the part that's been bothering me the most?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, here it goes!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only are you producing plenty of power, it's also clear that you're doing your best to be in step with everybody around you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! But you said this is the part that's bothering you the most, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Maybe go easy on the power...?
You can sound kinder, but still leave room for his resolve.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! You sound a lot kinder now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. But I also think you could put a little more focus on the fact that you're singing with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Singing with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Your character's gone from public disciplinarian to helpful hand, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, that's why...
You might want to sing like you're trying to encourage them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, encouragement!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was trying to sing like I was walking hand in hand with those next to me, but your idea might be more fitting for the character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd also like to take this opportunity to ask you all something. It has to do with the effects we're going to use for that song...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your advice.
I've come up with some better effects now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ And I came up with better acting ideas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm also glad I was able to find more areas where I can improve.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This really is nice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're making our show better by having discussions and testing out ideas together.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The people we were in that dream probably wouldn't have been able to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you seem rather happy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess I am.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys, look over there!
I think it's KAITO and the others!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With Luka on his back...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're probably late because it took them a long time to find her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Probably”? That has to be what happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's see what KAITO and the others think about what we just discussed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Rui
rows.Line:
Yes!
Let's!
